# Blue 42's Brewing Barn

> Family-owned craft beer, North Carolina wine, coffee bar, smoothies and homemade fudge in Moyock, NC (Currituck County), built on the Powell family farm land next to Powell's Roadside Market. Live music most weekends.

## Visit
- Address: 2132 Caratoke Highway, Moyock, NC 27958
- Phone: (252) 232-0757
- Email: blue42sbrewingbarn@gmail.com
- Coffee bar and cafe: every day 6:30 AM to 6:00 PM
- Beer and wine: Sunday to Thursday 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM; Friday and Saturday 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM
- Hours can shift seasonally; check Facebook or call before a special trip.
